title: Wubb Girlz Kung Fu Princesses: Attack of the Dirty Sock Monster
description: The Wubb Girlz in their feature film debut. Shine, Sparkle, and Shimmer must face off with the big baddie of dirty laundry. They’ll have to kung fu their way out of this.
quote: Wait, what’s that odor? It smells like dirty socks!
